title: ZeroSOC source profile: local override
description: What one deployment changes in a shipped source profile, and why. It holds only what differs: objects are laid over the shipped ones key by key (null removes a key), an entry of case_map replaces the shipped entry of the same path, the rules of alert_types are tried before the shipped ones, which stay as they are, and any other list is replaced whole. A block a profile does not have is refused. The profile that results is held to source_profile.schema.json and to the same coherence as a shipped one.

overrides.description: The source.id of the profile this is laid over. One written for another source is refused.

base_profile_version.description: The profile_version of the shipped profile this was written against. When the shipped profile moves past it the override is still read and is marked stale.

reason.description: Why the shipped profile is overridden here, and where the fix to the shipped profile is tracked. It is recorded with every run.

profile.description: The blocks of source_profile.schema.json that differ, each partial. The source block is not among them: an override changes what the records mean, never which source they come from.
